title: SMB with high temp targets but working
body:
As the title says, I can't get SMBs to work with high temp targets. Ignore the typo in the title.

They work fine for any TT of 5.5 or below, but despite the option for using SMB with a high TT being enabled, they just don't fire.

I have some automations running to catch highs and I don't necessarily want to set an overly aggressive TT. I have adjusted all of these automations to have a target of 5.5 or below, and manually set TT of above and below 5.5 to verify and can confirm on my setup at least, they definitely do not fire with a TT higher than 5.5

AAPS 2.8.2
Android 11
Samsung Galaxy S21 Ultra
Omnipod pump and RileyLink
![Screenshot_20210303-183706_AndroidAPS](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/42671801/109856184-1ca98900-7c51-11eb-85cf-17367fb236c0.png)

 Reporting bugs
--------------
- **Note the precise time the problem occurred** and describe the circumstances and steps that caused
  the problem
- Note the Build version (found in the About dialog in the app, when pressing the three dots in the
  upper-right corner).
- Obtain the app's log files, which can be found on the phone in
  _/storage/emulated/0/Android/data/info.nightscout.androidaps/_
  See https://androidaps.readthedocs.io/en/latest/EN/Usage/Accessing-logfiles.html
- Open an issue at https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/issues/new

comments.body: Have a look at the OpenAPS SMB Tab, that will show you why SMB's are disabled despite setting the above settings.

@Tornado-Tim Is there anything in particular I should be looking for on that tab? Any typical messages that should show?

I find it a bit odd that it will fire SMBs just fine when I set a target of, say, 5 mmol/L, but yet won't when aiming for the higher, and technically safer/not as near to hypo status 6 mmol/L
